rejections.message: This roots op replaces "card", but the UI already exists: root "card" with 21 nodes (rev 1). Do not start over: fix the existing document by patching it (patch fields, set missing nodes under their existing parents with the same ids, remove what is wrong).

This set creates a new canvas "flights", but the UI already exists: root "card" with 21 nodes (rev 1). Do not start over: fix the existing document by patching it (patch fields, set missing nodes under their existing parents with the same ids, remove what is wrong).
Variables are kept per canvas id or "page_variables"; "flights" is neither.

Replacing "card" drops its children "wrap", which exist: they would be left under no parent. To change "card", patch it ({"op": "patch", "id": "card", "patch": {...}}: it keeps its children); to replace it, keep them in "children" (or move or remove them first).
